webhook.controls: Unbounded add/remove webhook cards, DNS name

client.controls: Exclusive Service / masked HTTPS URL; namespace text; real Service metadata reference; bounded port; absolute path; CA presence only
client.union: Atomic remove opposite Service/URL branch; never replace clientConfig

webhookBehavior.controls: Explicit side effects; ordered protocol list; omitted/Fail/Ignore; bounded 1–30 seconds

webhookMatching.controls: Include-rule cards; operation/version/group/resource lists; scope choice; full label equality and In/NotIn/Exists/DoesNotExist expressions; named CEL conditions

policyMatching.controls: Matching rules and advanced exclusions; named resource lists; selectors; match policy; up to 64 CEL conditions

validations.controls: Repeatable multiline CEL; failure message; advanced reason and message CEL; evaluation failure choice

mutations.controls: Required Never/IfNeeded; ordered repeatable ApplyConfiguration/JSONPatch strategy and typed CEL expression; evaluation failure choice
mutations.union: Atomic strategy/expression branch change removes only inactive mutation expression

policyAdvanced.controls: Optional parameter type add/remove; repeatable ordered variable names and CEL

audit.controls: Repeatable audit key and value CEL

binding.controls: Exact real policy reference/manual entry; no-parameter/name/selector union; optional namespace; explicit Allow/Deny when missing
binding.scope: Parameter namespace omission is never guessed; follows actual referenced parameter type and admitted request namespace

enforcement.controls: Deny/Warn/Audit checkboxes; empty selection and Deny+Warn stay local and block submission

bindingMatching.controls: Optional match intersection with full rules, exclusions and selectors; no mutation validationActions

status.controls: Read-only observed generation; condition type/status; warning count; no source-derived warning text

ownership.createEdit: All six authorable only with host-admitted discovery, installed schema and operation authorization.
ownership.inspectOnly: Inspect intent, trusted controller/system ownership, controller ownerReference, or explicit managed-by metadata. Status is never owned.
ownership.identity: Host owns metadata.name, namespace omission, API identity and edit resourceVersion/UID locks.
ownership.fallback: Alpha mutating policy versions, unsupported field shapes and absent schema remain source-only without conversion.
ownership.feature: MutatingAdmissionPolicy is default-off at pinned baseline. Exact newly gated GVK discovery proves server availability; explicit absent/denied/unavailable feature evidence still blocks the form. No fictitious mandatory feature flag or controller health grant.
ownership.noActions: No synthetic admission mutation action, CEL evaluator, certificate validator, controller health, companion resource or success result.

fixtures: fixtures.ts: admissionFixtures and admissionScenario cover six kinds, create/edit, managed, denied, discovery-unknown, gate-off, unsupported, invalid-actions, lookup-denied; local harness adds ready/empty/denied/absent/unavailable reference transport.
regressions: admission.test.tsx: valid complete schemas for all six, client union preserving masked CA and unknown siblings, credential URL rejection, local timeout across sibling/section changes, CEL edits preserving comments and exact integer, local Deny+Warn conflict, mutation strategy and DELETE restriction, controller ownership rejection, source/gate/discovery boundaries.
